第十二章 母女初交手(1)
童家奴仆得到消息，能赶到的全赶到了二门门口。
徐家的马车门鹅蛋脸，眉色如墨，双眸如水，高鼻红唇，细长的脖颈，衬着乌黑的发髻，插着一根羊脂白玉簪。
童家人人闻名却不曾见面的大小姐就这般现于众人眼前。
有童家的老仆人看得倒抽一口冷气。
就是初次看到的奴仆也忍不住赞一句，“大小姐真是好端庄啊！”
老奴仆却低低应了一句，“这……这大小姐简直同原来的夫人一模一样。”
另一边，站在徐庭身边的童老爷也看得呆了眼，忍不住失声嚷道：“慧心？”
童悠悠闻声望过去，对这个亲生父亲有些失望，身形不高不矮，不过四十年纪下颚就留了三缕胡须，面色有些暗淡，眼白无神，眼下青黑，明显是纵情酒色。一身赭色锦缎长袍，不但没有为他添彩几分，反倒更显衰老。
同她想象中的中年文士，风度翩翩，简直大大不同。
但她一眼扫过，就垂了眉眼，蹲身行礼，“父亲，悠悠送了祖母安葬，回家来了。”
“好，好……”童老爷听得这话，蓦然惊觉这是大女儿，不是发妻，有些失落，只记得应了这么一句。
倒是童夫人恨得手里帕子都要绞碎了，但还是笑着上前挡住童老爷望向女儿的目光，道：“老爷，这真是大小姐吗？可真是太好了，方才妾身一直害怕，怕希望落空，大小姐虽然遭了些苦难，到底平安归来了。”
这话倒是点醒了童老爷，他脸色立刻有些难看起来，“悠悠，你不是被山贼劫去了吗？怎么回来了？”
他想问女儿还是不是清白之身，但到底不好问出口。
徐庭在旁边却是鄙夷至极，开口替童悠悠道：“说起这个，本官倒是好奇，想要问问童老爷，你们府里到底是从哪里得的消息说大小姐遭了山贼被杀死？本官的嫂子带了族人从老家进京，路上碰到山贼劫掠，见到被奴仆抛下的童大小姐，我们嫂子心善，就带着童小姐一路走来。路上也没有派人给贵府送信，贵府居然先办了丧事，还立了衣冠冢，倒是神速至极啊。”
童老爷听得愣神，下意识望向童夫人。
他对这个大女儿也是多年不见，没什么感情。老母亲过世，他托了很多人情，才免了丁忧，那段时日夜夜笙歌，倒是没注意太多细节。难得回府时，夫人只说大女儿回京路上死得不光彩，他还有几分不耐烦，甚至庆幸她没有死在京都附近，不会被人议论嘲笑。
今日突然被人问了，他这才同样惊奇，到底谁给自家送了信？
童夫人后背的冷汗差点流成河水，原本笃定童悠悠死了，她才草草做了个衣冠冢，没想到童悠悠居然没死，怪不得刘福他们没一个回来。

她低头装作抹泪，好不容易扯了个谎，“老爷，这事怪妾身，那日为了老夫人的忌日忙得昏头转向，有个商队的镖师上门来送口信，说是大小姐惨死，妾身伤心之下，也没来得及问问这人是何处来的……
“都怪妾身，老爷，呜呜……老夫人和大小姐都过世，妾身日日吃斋念佛，就想保佑她们在天之灵安宁，如今大小姐果然平安归来了，妾身真是太高兴了。”
明明是被怀疑的对象，一番话硬是把自己塑造成了一个孝顺媳妇、慈爱继母，真是让人佩服。
童老爷果然立刻开口劝她，“好了，不过是小事，悠悠也平安回来了，谁也不会计较这些。”
徐夫人几乎要忍不住翻白眼了，她上前两步扶着童夫人的胳膊，好似生怕她太过伤心，故意转开话头，“以前见过几次，只觉得妹妹柔弱，今日见了才发现妹妹貌美。不知妹妹这湖蓝的缎子在哪里买的，颜色实在是好。
“还有这金钗也别致，方才瞧着贵府二小姐脖子上那嵌宝项圈，还有压裙子的翡翠玉环都很精巧，不知在哪家银楼买的，可要推荐给我去逛逛。”
童夫人恨得咬牙，也不好甩开徐夫人的手，抬头瞄了一眼童老爷的脸色，果然有些不好，她赶紧道：“好啊，改日约了姊姊一起去。我们先去后院喝茶说话吧，悠悠怕是也累了。”
徐夫人这才放过她，回身扶了徐大娘，一起随着童夫人去了后院。
童老爷赶紧也请徐庭去书房。
他本就为妻女不懂礼心虚，无奈徐庭不改御史本色，进了书房，一句又一句，除了孝道，就是后宅不宁，仕途不兴。
童老爷简直听得如坐针毡，好不容易熬得后宅来人禀报——
“老爷，徐夫人和大夫人上了马车了。”
徐大人这才起身告辞，最后还道：“童大人，悠悠这孩子孝顺懂礼，我家嫂子很是喜爱，已经认作义女。我夫人更是把悠悠当做亲闺女，若不是悠悠坚持，我夫人恨不得把她留在府里一辈子。以后，我们家里怕是要常同悠悠来往，若有打扰，还望海涵。”
“不敢，不敢，都是应该的，徐大人言重了。”童老爷听了不是徐庭要常来，偷偷松了一口气。虽然他在礼部当差，但论起讲礼，真是差了徐大人十万八千里，再听下去，他都要疯了。
待徐家马车出了大门，童老爷扭头就要往后院走去，不想迎面却见到匆匆出来的管家刘良。
刘良苦着脸，不等他开口问，就道：“老爷，您快去看看吧，夫人许是伤心太过，又病倒了，奴才赶着去请大夫。”
童老爷脚下一顿，觉得不耐烦。他不是不喜欢夫人柔弱可人，但动不动就病倒，他也忍不住厌烦。比起那些年轻貌美、香气怡人的青楼美人，自家夫人房里的药味就太难闻了。
他想了想道：“一会儿告诉夫人，我晚上有个诗会，不好缺席，今晚就不回来了，让她好好养病。另外，大小姐那边，好好安顿，不可怠慢。”
“是，老爷。”刘良赶紧应下。
眼见童老爷出了大门上了自家马车，刘良扭头又回后院，哪有要去请大夫。

主院的正房里，童悠悠慢慢喝着茶水，虎妞一脸不满的站在主子身后，偶尔瞪几眼门口的丫鬟婆子，好似随时要冲上去揍她们一顿。
旁边的内室里，童夫人不时咳嗽几声，在安静的屋里屋外，显得越发清晰。
很快，刘良就赶了过来，挥手示意丫鬟婆子们出去守着，然后他才走到内室门口，禀告道：“夫人，老爷说有个诗会，不能推托，已经出门去了。老爷嘱咐夫人好好养身体，不可操劳太过。”说罢，他瞄了一眼不动神色的童悠悠，便退到一旁。
吱呀一声，内室门被推开，童夫人迈步走了出来，哪还有一丝生病的模样。
虎妞瞪大眼睛，若不是被主子扯了衣角，她简直要跳起来了。
童夫人冷哼一声，坐在主位上，尖声呵斥，“大小姐的规矩可是跟老夫人学的？见了母亲不知该跪下磕头吗？”
童悠悠放下茶碗，抬眼望向她，根本没有起身，只淡淡应了一句，“夫人怕是忘了，我母亲已经过世了。”
童夫人最是痛恨旁人提到她填房的身分，当即就恼了，厉声命令，“给我狠狠的掌嘴！”
刘良上前就要动手，冷不防旁边却窜出虎妞，跳起来一巴掌就搧到他脸上，打得他一个后仰就摔了出去。

Chapter 12 The first encounter between mother and daughter (1)
After the Tong family's servants got the news, all those who could make it rushed to the second door.
The Xu family has an oval face, ink-colored eyebrows, watery eyes, a high nose and red lips, a slender neck, and a black bun with a white jade hairpin inserted in mutton fat.
The eldest lady of the Tong family, who was well-known to everyone but had never met, appeared in front of everyone.
The old servant of Youtong's family gasped when he saw this.
Even the slave who saw it for the first time couldn't help but praise, "Miss, you are so dignified!"
The old servant responded in a low voice, "This... this young lady is exactly the same as the original lady."
On the other side, Mr. Tong, who was standing next to Xu Ting, was also dumbfounded. He couldn't help shouting: "Huixin?"
When Tong Youyou heard that his reputation had passed, he was a little disappointed with this biological father. He was neither tall nor short, but he had three strands of beard on his chin when he was forty years old. His complexion was a little dull, the whites of his eyes were dull, and his eyes were blue and black, which was obviously a sign of indulgence in drinking. He was wearing an ocher brocade robe, which not only did not add to his appearance, but actually made him look older.
It was completely different from the middle-aged scribe she had imagined, with a graceful demeanor.
But after she glanced at her, she lowered her eyebrows and knelt down to salute, "Father, Youyou has sent your grandmother to be buried and is back home."
"Okay, okay..." When Mr. Tong heard this, he was suddenly surprised to realize that this was his eldest daughter, not his first wife. He was a little disappointed, so he only remembered saying this.
Mrs. Tong was so angry that she wanted to shred the handkerchief in her hand, but she still smiled and stepped forward to block Master Tong from looking at his daughter, saying, "Master, is this really the eldest lady? It's so wonderful. I have been afraid just now, fearing that my hope will be lost. Although the eldest lady has suffered some hardships, she has returned safely."
These words woke up Mr. Tong, and his face immediately became a little ugly, "Yuyou, weren't you kidnapped by bandits? Why did you come back?"
He wanted to ask his daughter if she was still innocent, but it was difficult to ask.
Xu Ting, who was standing next to him, was extremely contemptuous and said for Tong Youyou: "Speaking of this, I am curious and want to ask Mr. Tong, where did your family get the news that the eldest lady was killed by bandits? My sister-in-law brought her clan members from her hometown. Jing, when we encountered bandits on the road and saw Miss Tong abandoned by her slaves, our sister-in-law was kind-hearted, so she took Miss Tong along the way. She didn't send anyone to deliver a message to your mansion, but your mansion actually held the funeral first and erected a tomb. It was so fast. "
Mr. Tong was stunned when he heard this, and subconsciously looked at Mrs. Tong.
He has not seen his eldest daughter for many years and has no feelings for her. When his old mother passed away, he had to rely on many favors to save Ding You. During that time, he played music day and night without paying much attention to details. On the rare occasion when he returned home, his wife only said that his eldest daughter had died an ignominious death on the way back to the capital. He was still a little impatient. He was even glad that she did not die near Kyoto and would not be talked about and ridiculed by others.
He was also surprised when he was suddenly asked today, who sent the letter to his family?
The cold sweat on Mrs. Tong's back almost turned into a river. She was originally sure that Tong Youyou was dead, so she hastily made a burial mound. Unexpectedly, Tong Youyou was not dead. No wonder none of Liu Fu and the others came back.
She lowered her head and pretended to wipe her tears, and finally lied, "Master, this is my fault. I was so busy that day for the old lady's death anniversary. A caravan escort came to deliver a message, saying that the eldest lady died tragically. I was so sad that I didn't have time to ask where this person came from...
"It's all my fault, Master, wuwu... The old lady and the eldest lady both passed away. I eat fast and chant Buddha every day, just to protect their souls in heaven. Now that the eldest lady has returned safely, I am so happy. "
She was clearly the target of suspicion, but she managed to portray herself as a filial daughter-in-law and loving stepmother with just a few words, which is really admirable.
Sure enough, Mr. Tong immediately advised her, "Okay.It's just a trivial matter, and Yoyo is back safely, so no one will care about it. "
Mrs. Xu almost couldn't help rolling her eyes. She took two steps forward and supported Mrs. Tong's arm, as if she was afraid that she would be too sad, and deliberately turned away the conversation, "I have met her several times before, but I only thought that my sister is weak. After meeting her today, I realized that my sister is beautiful. I don’t know where my sister bought this lake blue satin. The color is really good.
"And this gold hairpin is also unique. Just now I saw the jewel-embedded necklace on the neck of the second lady of your house, and the jade jade ring that holds the skirt. They are very exquisite. I don't know which bank I bought them from, but you can recommend them to me."
Mrs. Tong gritted her teeth with hatred and could not shake off Mrs. Xu's hand. She raised her head and glanced at Mr. Tong's face. Sure enough, there was something bad about her face. She quickly said: "Okay, I have made an appointment with my sister another day. Let's go to the backyard to drink tea and talk first. Youyou is probably tired too."
Mrs. Xu let her go, turned around, helped Aunt Xu, and followed Mrs. Tong to the backyard.
Mr. Tong quickly invited Xu Ting to the study.
He already felt guilty because of his wife and daughter's lack of etiquette, but Xu Ting did not change his true nature as a censor. He entered the study and said one sentence after another, besides filial piety, he was restless at home and his career was not prosperous.
Mr. Tong felt like he was sitting on pins and needles hearing this, and he finally managed to get someone from the back house to report——
"Sir, Mrs. Xu and the eldest lady have boarded the carriage."
Mr. Xu then stood up to leave, and finally said: "Mr. Tong, this child Youyou is filial and polite. My sister-in-law loves her very much and has already recognized her as her adopted daughter. My wife even regards Youyou as her biological daughter. If she hadn't insisted on it, my wife would have wanted to keep her in the house for the rest of her life. From now on, our family will have to often interact with Youyou. If there is any interruption, I hope Haihan will do it."
"I don't dare, I don't dare, it's all right. Mr. Xu said it hard." Master Tong secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he heard that it wasn't Xu Ting who wanted to come often. Although he is on duty in the Ministry of Etiquette, when it comes to teaching etiquette, he is really far behind Mr. Xu. If he continues to listen to it, he will go crazy.
When the Xu family's carriage left the gate, Mr. Tong turned around and was about to walk to the backyard. He didn't want to meet the butler Liu Liang who came out in a hurry.
Liu Liang had a grimace on his face, and before he could ask, he said, "Master, please go and have a look. My wife may have been too sad and fell ill again, so I rushed to call the doctor."
Master Tong paused, feeling impatient. It's not that he doesn't like the fact that his wife is weak and sweet, but he can't help but be annoyed by her falling ill at every turn. Compared with those young, beautiful and pleasant-smelling brothel beauties, the smell of medicine in my wife's room is too unpleasant.
He thought for a moment and said, "I'll tell Madam later that I have a poetry meeting tonight. If I can't miss it, I won't be back tonight. Let her recover well. In addition, the eldest lady, please settle down well and don't neglect it."
"Yes, sir." Liu Liang quickly agreed.
Seeing Mr. Tong exiting the gate and getting into his carriage, Liu Liang turned around and went back to the backyard, not wanting to ask for a doctor.
In the main room of the main courtyard, Tong Youyou slowly drank tea. Huniu stood behind her master with a dissatisfied look on her face, occasionally glaring at the maids and women at the door, as if she was about to rush up and beat them up at any time.
In the inner room next to her, Mrs. Tong coughed from time to time, which became clearer and clearer inside and outside the quiet room.
Soon, Liu Liang rushed over and waved to the maids and women to go out and guard. Then he walked to the door of the inner room and reported: "Madam, the master said there is a poetry meeting, so I can't shirk it. I have already gone out. The master asked my wife to take good care of her health and not to work too hard." After that, he glanced at Tong Youyou, who had a calm expression, and stepped aside.
With a creak, the door to the inner room was pushed open, and Mrs. Tong stepped out, not even looking sick at all.
Hu Niu's eyes widened, and if her master hadn't pulled her clothes off, she would have jumped up.
Mrs. Tong snorted coldly, sat on the main seat, and scolded sharply, "Did the eldest lady learn the rules from the old lady? Don't you know you should kneel down and kowtow when you see your mother?""
Tong Youyou put down the tea bowl and raised her eyes to look at her. She didn't get up at all and only responded lightly, "I'm afraid Madam has forgotten that my mother has passed away. "
Mrs. Tong hated it most when others mentioned her identity as a house filler. She immediately became angry and ordered sternly, "Slap me hard! "
Liu Liang stepped forward and was about to take action, but Huniu suddenly appeared next to him, jumped up and slapped him in the face, causing him to fall back and fall out.
